CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 03 / 13

Tax revenue and deadweight loss

Post-tax welfare稅後福利

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Compute consumer surplus, producer surplus and government revenue after a tax. In the standard model, total surplus is CS + PS + tax revenue.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

CS 用 Pb，PS 用 Ps，再加政府收入。稅款在標準福利分析中是轉移，不能把整筆稅收當作損失。

CS is computed using Pb, PS using Ps, and government revenue must be added to both. This counts tax payments as transfers within the standard welfare calculation rather than treating all tax as lost value.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：CS=120,PS=80,revenue=50. Total post-tax surplus=250. 三者相加。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

After tax CS=40,PS=30,revenue=20. Total surplus? 稅後總剩餘？
